title: Neuro-Kurisu SUPER — reconciled weighted implementation roadmap scorecard — WorkPass37
baseArchive: Neuro_Kurisu_WORKPASS36_2026-10-13.zip + durable ActionGateway receipts and external-observer/reafference integration
method: WorkPass37 adds durable, fail-closed ActionGateway idempotency across direct actions, reusable skill steps and project APIs; verified independently sourced postconditions flow through ExternalObserverFabric and can receive temporal credit only through an exact supplied decisionId. Receipt, outcome and observer projection finalize before completed receipt commit; receipt persistence failure blocks replay. Schema 225 migration is aligned and regression-tested from schemas 223/224. Retrieval benchmark time semantics now match baseline/candidate; synthetic uplift remains zero and candidate not promoted. Pass implementation progress is 85/100, distinct from weighted roadmap readiness. Real provider/device receipts, labelled temporal holdout, dependency-installed app build/browser Live2D E2E, clean-room restore/rollback and soak remain open.

workstreams.name: Canonical source lineage and single-owner architecture
workstreams.rationale: MemoryOS2 remains the sole writable owner. WorkPass31 centralizes all current production mutation classes behind MemoryFabric and persists a bounded receipt ledger through ordinary state migration; legacy direct-write adapter methods remain only for historical consumers.

workstreams.name: Runtime integration, API/UI routes and smoke/linkage coverage
workstreams.rationale: Runtime/server integration, route linkage and focused app script smoke pass; release metadata is synchronized to 35.59.0/schema 225. Full dependency-installed React/Vite build and real desktop/mobile browser Live2D E2E remain open.

workstreams.name: Memory 2.0, retrieval/admission and benchmark evidence
workstreams.rationale: MemoryOS2 canonical retrieval and bounded semantic path remain in place; WorkPass37 fixes the timestamp semantics of the synthetic benchmark. Current candidate is not promoted because synthetic recall uplift is zero; independent labelled temporal holdout and actual local model inference remain open.

workstreams.name: Agency, action schema, execution, outcome and reafference
workstreams.rationale: WorkPass37 now has tested durable, fail-closed ActionGateway receipt replay, idempotent skill steps, independently sourced postcondition integration and exact decision-linked temporal credit through the canonical observer path. Simulated end-to-end proof exists; actual external provider/device receipts and multi-provider reconnect/rollback remain open.

workstreams.name: Portable subject continuity and social/known-entity dossier
workstreams.rationale: Read-only dossier and fidelity contracts are present; browser-backed corrections and behavioral equivalence remain open.

workstreams.name: External transport, SDK, idempotency and replay
workstreams.rationale: Conscio/Hexis/WILL local idempotency, queue backpressure and ACK/replay contracts improved; remote provider receipt/reconnect proof remains open.

workstreams.name: Research promotion and controlled experiments
workstreams.rationale: WorkPass25 supplies a deterministic private-first temperature-scaling fitter with a group-disjoint validation fold, version/dataset-bound artifact contract, NLL/Brier/ECE eligibility thresholds and provenance propagation into evidence/restore. This is an implemented pipeline only: the real pinned pretrained model and independent final holdout have not been run.

workstreams.name: Release durability: build, E2E, rollback, soak, SBOM/provenance
workstreams.rationale: Release metadata and operational readiness reporting improved; dependency-complete app install/build, browser E2E, clean-room restore/rollback, soak and final SBOM/provenance remain open.
